evidence.text: Deployment D42 started as a 10% canary at 14:00 UTC; the remaining production pods stayed on D41.
From 14:08 through 14:14 UTC, checkout requests on D42 returned 5xx responses at 6.2%, while D41 returned 5xx responses at 0.4% after normalization for route and request mix.
Database latency stayed between 18 ms and 22 ms for both D41 and D42 throughout the interval, within its 15 ms to 25 ms baseline.
The canary policy requires stopping and rolling back a canary when its 5xx rate exceeds 2% for at least five consecutive minutes while the stable version remains below 1%.

evidence.text: Database migration M12 adds a nullable deployment_region column and is backward compatible with the currently deployed application D42.
Application D43 writes deployment_region during startup and refuses to start when the column is absent.
M12 has been applied and verified in region east; region west is still on the pre-M12 schema.
The rollout policy requires a backward-compatible schema migration to be applied and verified in every target region before deploying an application that depends on it.
